releaseNotes:
• PulseForge AI Lean MVP Architecture: 5 primary destinations (Home, Nutrition, Workout, Progress, Settings) with 7-entity Room local-first SQLite persistence.
• 100% Real Verified Data: Zero speculative numbers or duplicate placeholders; unrecorded data displays as '-'.
• Refined Visual System: Neo-Soft Lilac and Dark Obsidian styling matching user references with smooth wave charts and peak callout tooltips.
• Lean & Lightweight: Eliminated heavy OCR/ML bloat, reducing APK footprint from 54MB to 11.9MB.
• Complete Data Portability: One-tap local JSON backup and zero cloud dependencies.
